title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings

overview: Steven Grant, a mild-mannered gift shop employee, begins to experience blackouts and memories of another life. He soon discovers he has dissociative identity disorder and shares a body with mercenary Marc Spector, who becomes the conduit for the Egyptian moon god Khonshu.

As he comes into his super-powers, he must reconcile his alien Kryptonian heritage with his human upbringing, and ultimately become the iconic protector known as Superman when a new threat to humanity emerges.
production: DC Studios, Troll Court Entertainment, The Safran Company

title: How to Train Your Dragon
overview: In a Viking village where dragons are seen as enemies, young Hiccup dreams of proving himself a true warrior. But when he befriends a mysterious Night Fury dragon, he discovers that friendship and understanding can change both their worlds forever.
production: DreamWorks Animation, Universal Pictures, Marc Platt Productions

title: Beyond Skyline

overview: With the world now aware of his identity as Iron Man, Tony Stark must contend with both his declining health and a vengeful madman with ties to his father's legacy. As he faces new challenges, Stark must forge new alliances and confront a powerful new enemy.

title: Avengers: Infinity War

A despot of intergalactic infamy, his goal is to collect all six Infinity Stones and use them to inflict his twisted will on all of reality. Everything the Avengers have fought for has led up to this moment.

production: Paramount Pictures, Skydance, Hasbro, New Republic Pictures, Di Bonaventura Pictures

title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon

production: Paramount Pictures, Hasbro, Di Bonaventura Pictures, Ian Bryce Productions
